# Mascot AI

> Voice-first AI college counseling for high school students. Talk through your
> goals, get a college list that fits, and write stronger essays, all in one app.
> Currently in private beta.

## Pages

- [Features](https://mascot-ai.com/features/): Voice counseling, AI university matching, deep school data, essay coaching, profile builder, application planner.
- [Pricing](https://mascot-ai.com/pricing/): Explorer is free. Navigator adds more AI matching and essay coaching. One-time add-ons on either plan.
- [For Parents](https://mascot-ai.com/parents/): Link a parent account to a student for a read-only view of their profile and progress, plus billing management. Students stay in control of their work.
- [About](https://mascot-ai.com/about/): Why Mascot exists and how the product works end to end.
- [Guides](https://mascot-ai.com/blog/): Counselor-written guides on choosing college essay topics, building a balanced college list, self-discovery for applications, and the application timeline.
- [What's next](https://mascot-ai.com/coming-soon/): Roadmap: a counselor workspace and a scholarship finder.
- [Contact](https://mascot-ai.com/contact/): How to reach the team.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mascot-ai.com/privacy/)
- [Terms of Service](https://mascot-ai.com/terms/)

## Notes

- The web app lives at https://dev.mascot-ai.com and is invite-only during the beta.
- Beta access requests: https://forms.gle/Jbpa86AMPhssyeoi8
